 with(REC/'SOURCE_SYNC_CLAIM.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(dict(started_unix=time.time(),push_budget_s=30,read_budget_s=5),f)
 check=run(['git','diff','--cached','--check'],10);assert check.returncode==0
